integrity: Analytic proof and two reproducible finite-verification programs; previous general strong-total-cover/induced-matching identity is attributed to the source.
scientific_limitations: The induced-matching polynomial and minimum strong-total-cover cardinality hold for all two-dimensional rook graphs of factor orders at least two. Complete optimal-cover census holds only for two-row graphs. Computational checks are finite. Equivalent earlier formulations may exist. No independent audit is claimed.
title: Induced-matching polynomials of rook graphs and minimum strong-total-cover rigidity
